answer: Admission costs follow a 2x-convex ladder to halt spam: a single agent costs 1 unit, but 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000, ensuring a safe haven for honest nodes. A raven verifier checks each pulse, penalizing duplicates with total burn. This haven for verified logic scales costs per root; every pulse of incoming activity validates the chain. Like a raven seeking proof, the system limits cheap growth, forcing identity costs high.
